# Call Functions

## Description

This is an introductory package that was made during the 2025 Fall semester at the University of Oklahoma for the course MATH-4753 authored by Cody Van Dyke. There are a few basic function in this package and a data set. There are also two vignettes one discussing the birthday solution and another describing this package.

## scatterhist function

```{r}

RScriptsMATH4753F25VanDyke::scatterhist(x = 1:10, y = 11:20)

```


## myboot2 function

```{r}

set.seed(123)

x <- rnorm(30, mean = 5, sd = 2)

cap <- RScriptsMATH4753F25VanDyke::myboot2(x=x)

```


## mybin function

```{r}

RScriptsMATH4753F25VanDyke::mybinFunc()

```


## ntickets function

```{r}

RScriptsMATH4753F25VanDyke::ntickets(N = 400, gamma = 0.02, p = 0.95)

```

RScriptsMATH4753F25VanDyke::fire
